Row.Text: Enabling this option will automatically add farms, lumber huts, mines, and improvements for resources and remove these improvements from builders. Pillaged tiles will automatically be repaired after 20 turns.
Enabling this option removes sets the required number of amenities to 0 for all cities.
Enabling this option removes great people from the game.
Enabling this option removes military and all related items (units, buildings, techs, etc) from the game.
Enabling this option removes all policy cards from the game.
Enabling this option removes religion, faith, pantheons and all related items from the game.
Enabling this option removes most districts from the game. Buildings are instead built in the city centre.
